The size of the 3D picture, in percent of the screen's. Lower is faster and softer.
column2: 3D 画面的尺寸，占屏幕的百分比。越低越快，也越模糊。

column1: For weak phones: turns off bloom, depth of field and shadows, uses lighter textures and keeps the HUD sharp over a smaller 3D picture. It also sets the 3D resolution and the frame rate, and you can change all of them. Toaster: everything for speed and the battery before looks: 25%, 30 FPS, no reverb, and a lighter HUD and textures still.
column2: 面向低性能手机：关闭泛光、景深和阴影，使用更轻量的纹理，并在较小的 3D 画面上保持 HUD 清晰。它还会设置 3D 分辨率和帧率，这些都可以再改。烤面包机：速度与续航优先于画面：25%、30 FPS、无混响，HUD 和纹理也更轻量。

column1: Adreno only, at your own risk: load a Vulkan driver of your own. By default the system's is used.
column2: 仅限 Adreno，风险自负：加载自有的 Vulkan 驱动。默认使用系统驱动。

column2: FSR 4 无法启动，因此使用 FSR 3.1。log.txt 中的 [fsr4] 行说明了原因。

column1: The target icon, or a controller's right stick click, keeps the camera on the monster as in the newer games, and bows and bowguns fire at it. Off: the icon turns the camera to it once, as in the original game.

column2: 按下保存时作弊会开启或关闭，无需重启。关闭一项会撤销它对游戏代码的修改；它已经改过的数值（金钱、物品）会保留。新的作弊文件会在重启后出现。

column2: 将存档复制到你选择的文件夹，以便带到模拟器或其他设备。

column1: Sends the game's log to the app you choose, for whoever is helping you with a problem.

column2: 多重采样抗锯齿，用 F7 键循环切换模式

column2: 猎人、怪物和场景的阴影。关闭：没有阴影，在低性能 GPU 上稍快

column2: 以每色 16 位而非 8 位渲染画面，因此昏暗的天空和柔和的光晕不会出现色带。

column1: The shadows of hunters, monsters and scenery. Off: a little faster on a weak phone.
column2: 猎人、怪物和场景的阴影。关闭：在低性能手机上稍快。

column1: Some Adreno drivers repeat the 3D picture in a grid at a low 3D resolution: Auto keeps 2x MSAA there. If the picture looks dark or flickers, or for more speed, choose Off.
column2: 某些 Adreno 驱动在低 3D 分辨率下会以网格状重复显示 3D 画面：自动会在那里保持 2x MSAA。如果画面发暗或闪烁，或者为了更快，请选择关闭。

column1: A host's IP address, to play over a VPN. Empty: searches your network.
column2: 主机的 IP 地址，用于通过 VPN 游玩。留空：搜索你的网络。

column1: A hub server's address (name or IP, and :port if it is not 39510), to play over the internet with everyone who uses the same server: their hubs show when you search for hubs in the game. Empty: none, only your network.
column2: 大厅服务器的地址（名称或 IP，如果不是 39510 则加上 :端口），用于和所有使用同一服务器的人在互联网上游戏：在游戏中搜索大厅时，他们的大厅会显示出来。留空：无，仅限你的网络。

column1: On the hub server, only players with the same key see each other's hubs: agree on one with your friends. Empty: public hubs.
column2: 在大厅服务器上，只有使用相同密钥的玩家才能看到彼此的大厅：和好友约定一个。留空：公开大厅。

column1: The health of large monsters in Hub quests, by number of hunters. When you join a hub, the host's values are used.
column2: 大厅任务中大型怪物的生命值，按猎人数。加入大厅时，使用主机的数值。

column1: How much of the scene you see: higher shows more.
column2: 你能看到多少场景：越高看得越多。

column1: On a screen wider than 16:9, where the HUD goes.
column2: 在宽于 16:9 的屏幕上，HUD 的位置。

column1: Movies and menu backdrops fill the screen, with a little cut above and below, instead of bars at the sides.
column2: 影片和菜单背景会填满屏幕，上下略有裁切，而不是在两侧显示黑边。

column1: The most frames a second. A lower limit heats the phone less and saves battery.
column2: 每秒最多帧数。限制越低，手机发热越少，也越省电。

column1: Shows the frame rate and the phone's temperature on the screen.
column2: 在屏幕上显示帧率和手机温度。

column1: Smooths the edges of 3D models. It asks more of the GPU.
column2: 平滑 3D 模型的边缘。对 GPU 要求更高。

column1: Smooths the edges of the whole picture. On Mali GPUs it can leave a green line at the edge of the screen.
column2: 平滑整个画面的边缘。在 Mali GPU 上可能会在屏幕边缘留下一条绿线。

column1: How far away people in towns are drawn: 1 is the game's distance, 2 twice as far, 0 no limit.
column2: 城镇中人物会被绘制的距离：1 是游戏的距离，2 是两倍远，0 无限制。

column1: Rebuilds the picture from a lower resolution. It needs a Vulkan 1.2 GPU.
column2: 从较低分辨率重建画面。需要 Vulkan 1.2 GPU。

column1: How low the resolution goes before the picture is rebuilt.
column2: 画面重建前分辨率会降到多低。

column1: How sharp FSR leaves the picture.
column2: FSR 让画面保持多清晰。

column1: How A, B, X and Y are read on a controller. Position: as on the Switch. Label: by the letter printed on the button.
column2: 手柄上 A、B、X、Y 的读取方式。位置：与 Switch 相同。标签：按按键上印的字母。

column1: Auto: they show while no controller is connected.
column2: 自动：未连接手柄时显示。

column1: While the touch controls show, the HUD moves out of your thumbs' way.
column2: 显示触屏控制时，HUD 会移开拇指的位置。

column1: How far the camera turns for a drag.
column2: 拖动时镜头转动的幅度。

column1: How solid the touch controls look.
A short vibration when you press a touch control.
column2: 按下触屏控制时的短震动。

column1: The game's rumble on the phone too, with or without a controller.
column2: 游戏的震动也会传到手机，无论是否连接手柄。

column1: The port for local play hubs. Everyone must use the same one.
column2: 本地游玩大厅的端口。所有人都必须使用同一个。

column1: Small monsters are the same for every player. Experimental: they may stop attacking.
column2: 小型怪物对每个玩家都相同。实验性：它们可能会停止攻击。

column1: In the Hub, L or R while choosing a quest shows the Village quests, to play them with others.
column2: 在大厅选择任务时按 L 或 R 会显示村庄任务，以便和其他人一起游玩。

column1: A Village quest played in the Hub first multiplies the monster's health by this.
column2: 在大厅游玩村庄任务时，会先将怪物的生命值乘以这个数值。

column1: The game stops while you are out of the app.
column2: 你离开应用时游戏会停止。

column1: Copies the free downloadable content (event quests, item packs, Palicoes) to a save that has not received it yet.
column2: 将免费可下载内容（活动任务、物品包、随从猫）复制到尚未收到它的存档。

column1: Allow controller input in the background
Comma-separated host[:port] addresses. Use Local Wireless in MHGU. Internet hosts need port forwarding.
column2: 逗号分隔的 host[:port] 地址。在 MHGU 中使用本地无线。互联网主机需要端口转发。

column1: Village quests at the Hub counter
column2: 大厅柜台处的村庄任务
大厅中的村庄任务 HP

column1: Import missing bonus content from donor save
column2: 从其他存档导入缺失的附赠内容

column1: Saved. Restart for display, controls and network changes.
column2: 已保存。显示、控制和网络更改需重启生效。

column1: Save to apply. Unsaved changes are discarded on close.
column2: 保存以应用。未保存的更改会在关闭时丢弃。

column1: D-pad: Move   A: Select / edit   L / R: Section
column2: 十字键：移动   A：选择 / 编辑   L / R：分区

column1: Exit the game? Unsaved progress will be lost. Save in MHGU before closing.
column2: 退出游戏？未保存的进度将丢失。关闭前请在 MHGU 中保存。

column1: Unsaved game progress will be lost.
column2: 未保存的游戏进度将丢失。

column2: 游戏文件不完整：romfs 有 %d 个文件，而 1.4.0 版本有 35531%s 个。\n\n请重新打开游戏查看所需内容，并选择另一个文件夹。
